rule: never edited by hand; regenerate with `rupture cascade refresh-fixtures` and re-record provenance
why: Offline slices of the real USGS ShakeMap and the real USGS ground-failure product for Gorkha, so the reproduction comparison in docs/CASCADE.md and the validate-cascade gate run with no network. The CSVs carry the original cell values verbatim; nothing is interpolated, smoothed or synthesised.

shakemap_grid_slice.csv.notes: Rows of <grid_data> whose LON/LAT fall in the fixture window padded by 0.05 deg and extended north to 28.40 deg so the serac AOI lhende-khola-trishuli (the Langtang 2015 mechanism) is inside the sampled grid, with columns LON, LAT, PGA (%g), PGV (cm/s), SVEL (Vs30, m/s) kept verbatim; MMI and the three PSA columns dropped. ShakeMap Atlas, shakemap_version 1, code_version 4.0.2+335.gcbad862, processed 2020-06-03. This is the same ShakeMap version the ground-failure product below was computed from (info.json: shakemap_version 1). Grid spacing 0.0166667 deg.

usgs_zhu_2017_general_coverage_slice.csv.notes: Published Zhu et al. (2017) general-model output, areal coverage (proportion of area affected). Parent raster is 2228x1912 at 1/240 deg, EPSG:4326. The fixture takes every 4th cell in each direction inside the window (0.0166663 deg effective spacing); cell values and cell-centre coordinates are the parent's, unmodified. Values are the product's own 4-dp rounding.

usgs_jessee_2018_coverage_slice.csv.notes: Published Nowicki Jessee et al. (2018) output, areal coverage. The product file is named jessee_2017 (preprint year); the paper is 2018. Parent raster is 4455x3824 at 1/480 deg, EPSG:4326. The fixture takes every 8th cell in each direction inside the window (0.0166667 deg effective spacing); values and coordinates are the parent's, unmodified.

usgs_ground_failure_info.json.notes: Committed byte-for-byte. Records which models the product ran, their extents, the aggregate-hazard and population-exposure alert values, and the note that the unconsolidated-sediment lithology coefficient was changed to -1.36 from -3.22.
